narrative: Demand for PL1__M90CD9A1 is moderate and largely stationary (CV=0.164, negligible trend) with a left-skewed profile driven by periodic low-demand events. Lead times are volatile (CV=0.501, mean 2.51 days), justifying a meaningful safety buffer. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is chosen: the EOQ of 165,972 units dominates the MOQ and is unconstrained by storage capacity (65.5% utilisation). Setting safety stock at 34,968 units achieves the 95% service level target at a 21.8% lower total annual cost versus the SAP baseline.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is near-continuous and stationary with moderate variability; the (r,Q) policy is optimal for such patterns as it minimises combined ordering and holding costs while providing a deterministic reorder trigger aligned with volatile lead times.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity utilisation is 65.5% — no capacity constraint binds. MOQ (60,793) is well below EOQ (165,972) and is non-binding. No boundary risk identified.
